label: Ledge in Ravine
literalRoomDescription: You are on a narrow ledge near the bottom of a deep ravine. The ledge continues to the west. A precarious climb up to another tiny ledge is possible. A short scramble down the rock face leads to a stream.
safeSceneProfile: Narrow near-bottom ravine ledge, west continuation, precarious upward climb and short scramble to stream below; no invented ladder.
